item.title: Dzulkefly: MOH Shifting To ‘Targeted’ Drug Stockpiling After Previous Covid Vaccine Wastage
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MOH is shifting to targeted, data-driven stockpiling after Covid-19 vaccine wastage, focusing on critical, fast-moving and single-source medicines, says Dr Dzul. MOH has set an April 15 deadline for pharma companies to report product availability levels. item.description:

Naphtha, a vital petroleum derivative used in plastic manufacturing and petrochemicals, is essential for the production of these items.
